basis: current working tree audit; no network, CUDA, real Flickr downloads, real BioCLIP weights, caches, parquet outputs, DuckDB files, or model weights inspected
working_tree_note: The audit was performed with pre-existing uncommitted Phase 8 edits in scripts/generate_report_pack.py, src/flickr_bio_occurrence/evidence/rules.py, tests/test_evidence_rules.py, and tests/test_report_pack.py. Those implementation/test edits are not part of this Phase 0 report commit.

current_working_tree_semantics.bronze: negative visual material detected from evidence fields or non-butterfly-like BioCLIP label
current_working_tree_semantics.in_review: missing image, API error, missing BioCLIP, low confidence non-target, or ambiguous classification

current_publication_state_logic.risk: This file has uncommitted Phase 8 implementation changes, so committed main may differ until that work is completed.

category_and_lifestage_columns.notes: No stored image_category or life_stage column was found in the inspected active source/test paths. Life-stage labels and text terms exist, but they are mapped into triage/review reasons rather than stored as normalized category columns.

caterpillar.current_handling: BioCLIP caterpillar labels are negative material unless human_verification_detected and species_text_match make them verified life-stage evidence in classify_bioclip_triage. Text term caterpillar is currently in NON_TARGET_ORDER_TERMS.

pupa_chrysalis.current_handling: BioCLIP pupa/chrysalis labels are negative material unless human_verification_detected and species_text_match make them verified life-stage evidence in classify_bioclip_triage. Text terms pupa/chrysalis are currently in NON_TARGET_ORDER_TERMS.

egg.current_handling: absent from inspected BioCLIP labels, negative-label maps, and review text terms

image_triage.meaning: negative/non-occurrence visual material such as specimen, artwork, moth, caterpillar, pupa/chrysalis, other insect, not butterfly, object/background, or AI generated

publication_state.meaning: working-tree Phase 8 WIP maps negative material to bronze

legacy_storage_names: src/flickr_bio_occurrence/pipeline/transforms.py uses bronze_flickr_photo for flattened raw search rows
src/flickr_bio_occurrence/pipeline/dry_run.py reports data/bronze, data/silver, and data/gold paths
src/flickr_bio_occurrence/storage/duckdb_index.py creates views from bronze/silver/gold parquet paths

image_deletion_logic.behavior: Successful image files are deleted by default after classification. Failed image files are deleted by default in classify_bronze_photo_row unless keep_failed_images=True. cleanup_cached_image refuses to delete paths outside cache_root or under protected cache path parts such as huggingface, .hf-cache, model, or models.

flickr_query_lanes.original_mode: url_o only when ImageSelectionPolicy(mode='original_diagnostic') is used, with original pixel guardrail

comment_fetch_logic.current_behavior: Command returns implemented=false; no real comments API fetch is implemented. Existing comments embedded in raw payloads can be parsed by src/flickr_bio_occurrence/evidence/extractor.py.

redundant_code_candidates.reason: Superseded by lean image triage output, but still covered by existing compatibility tests.
Legacy storage view names are inconsistent with image-triage table semantics.
Dry-run output paths still describe occurrence-publication tiers.
Function name carries old Bronze tier wording although behavior is temporary image classification.
